eventMetadata.context_description: Persistent southwest monsoon (habagat) conditions, reinforced by distant tropical systems, are driving widespread cloud cover and scattered thunderstorms across Metro Manila, limiting daytime insolation and capping maximum temperatures near or slightly above seasonal averages of 31°C. Official PAGASA guidance and ensemble model outputs point to afternoon highs of 30–32°C under moderate southwest winds and high humidity, with recent observations showing suppressed peaks due to persistent overcast skies. Market-implied probabilities cluster tightly on 31°C and 32°C because small variations in rainfall timing or cloud breaks could shift the daily maximum by 1°C, while stronger monsoon flow would favor the lower end. Traders are monitoring the next PAGASA and GFS/ECMWF updates for any shift in steering patterns or moisture influx ahead of the August 23 observation window.
